suites.unmet_note: The proportional-capacity null control did not meet its NO_PENALTY expectation. Its three drivers are decomposed in threshold-case-results.json and recorded as deviation D-018-01.
suites.outcome_note: PASS means every case executed and produced a verdict against its preregistered expectation. It does not mean every expectation was met; one was not, and that is reported rather than hidden.

suites.coverage_assertion: test_every_preregistered_falsifier_is_evaluated compares the declared set against the recorded set.

suites.volatile_exclusion_note: compute_seconds records host wall time for the grid and is execution evidence rather than a result. The exclusion is declared in the reproduction report rather than applied silently.

first_pass_detail: The first execution of the focused suite failed one test: the tandem-queue closed form had been asserted as a serial sum, which the correctly pipelined model beat. Repaired under MC-018-01 and pinned by three tests.
defect_detail: MC-018-01: a wrong closed-form assertion in my own test, found by the first suite run.
MC-018-02: the preregistered latency materiality rule conflated an absolute level with a relative penalty, found when F-018-2 fired on the control ladder.
MC-018-03: falsifier F-018-5 attached a global consequence to twelve distinct frontier objects, found on the full 32-seed grid.
MC-018-05: the immutable readback ran the clean-clone suite without first checking the throwaway clone out to the immutable commit, found by the first readback attempt, which failed loudly.
